page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r6.26xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. Built on the x86_64 CPU architecture, the server features 104 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8269CY processors operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. It includes 768.0 GB of system RAM, providing an average resource density of approximately 7.38 GB of memory per vCPU core. The server configuration includes no local ephemeral storage, relying instead on network-attached block storage for persistent data requirements. Networking capabilities include a baseline network bandwidth of 25 Gbps. No discrete GPU hardware accelerators are available on this server type.

The primary architectural distinction of the ecs.r6.26xlarge is its high RAM-to-vCPU allocation ratio, offering resource density targeted at memory-bound enterprise applications. Hardware tradeoffs include the total absence of local NVMe storage drives, requiring administrators to provision network block storage volumes for disk operations, as well as the lack of hardware acceleration for machine learning training workloads. The high count of 104 dedicated vCPUs combined with 768.0 GB RAM provides qualitative efficiency for large single-node software deployments by avoiding distributed cluster overhead. Workloads suited for this hardware configuration include large in-memory databases, high-capacity caching systems, data analytics processing, and memory-intensive enterprise application platforms.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r6.26xlarge is a memory-optimized cloud server instance designed for memory-intensive enterprise workloads. Built on the x86_64 architecture and managed via a KVM hypervisor, it features 104 dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY vCPUs operating at a baseline clock speed of 2.5 GHz alongside 768.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 7.38 GB of RAM per vCPU core. The instance offers 25 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth and contains no integrated local NVMe storage or discrete GPU hardware accelerators. Because local storage is not included, persistent data operations depend on network-attached block storage volumes. The high memory density relative to compute capacity makes this server profile appropriate for hosting large in-memory databases, enterprise-scale caching clusters, complex data analytics pipelines, and memory-bound transactional workloads.
